title: Polytopes of alternating sign matrices with dihedral symmetries
summary: We study the convex hulls of $n \times n$ alternating sign matrices invariant under subgroups of the dihedral group of the square. For each non-trivial symmetry class, the symmetry determines the full matrix affinely from a smaller set of entries, allowing us to study the corresponding convex hull in a lower-dimensional space.
